title: Universal Spacelikeness Estimates and Liouville Rigidity for Lorentzian $σ_k$ Curvature Equations
summary: We study nonnegative entire spacelike graphs in Lorentz--Minkowski space satisfying $σ_k(A[u])=u^p$. For $2\le k<n$ and $p\ge k$, pointwise strict spacelikeness and closed $k$-admissibility yield universal bounds for the height and Lorentz factor. Their proof combines block coercivity in the full Gårding cone, a Lorentzian cutoff, and hyperbolic-cap comparison. For $2\le k<n/2$ and $k\le p\le k(n+2)/(n-2k)$, every such solution vanishes, without symmetry, decay, finite-energy, curvature-pinching, or global Hessian assumptions.
